text: Austria here. I want a peaceful start. I will not move against anyone who does not move against me. My plan this year is to hold my home centers and take none of the neutral Balkan centers by force if others stay out. Italy: I am open to an agreement that neither of us enters the other's home centers, and I will not move into Venice or Rome. Russia and Turkey: I'm open to discussing the Balkans (SER, RUM, GRE, BUL) so we avoid each other's units. Please reply with your intentions.

Hi France, England here. I'd like a quiet west. I propose keeping the English Channel empty: I stay out of ENG and you stay out of ENG and NTH-adjacent coasts. You take Iberia, I go north to Norway. If that works for you, we can coordinate against Germany later. Deal?

Hi Germany, England here. I'm heading for Norway and want no trouble with you. Suggest you take Denmark and Holland, I won't contest them in 1901. Keep Helgoland empty and I'll keep fleets off your coast. Open to working together against France or Russia later.

Hi Russia, England here. Proposal: Norway is mine, Sweden is yours, and I won't send anything toward St Petersburg. If you keep your north fleet in the Gulf of Bothnia/Sweden we can both grow peacefully. Interested?

France to England: I propose we stay out of each other's way. I'll take Belgium and Spain/Portugal in the west and won't touch your fleets in the Channel or North Sea. If you want to shift toward Norway or Denmark, I won't contest it. Let me know if you agree.

France to Germany: I'd like a non-aggression pact. I won't move into Burgundy-Ruhr-Munich or Belgium while you keep out of Paris and Brest. If you'd rather strike east toward Russia or Austria, that works for me too.
France to Italy: I have no plans against you. I'm looking at Spain and Tunis. If you move into Tunis or Piedmont early, let's talk about how we split things.

Germany here. I propose a open, peaceful start: no one attacks anyone in 1901. I will not move against France or Austria, and I am not hostile toward Russia. Keep your builds defensive and let's each take neutral centers (Denmark, Holland, Belgium, Sweden, Norway) without stepping on each other. Happy to share intel. Who wants to coordinate against the strongest power later?

Italy here. I'm playing defensively and want no early wars. Happy to keep the Adriatic quiet and coordinate against any power that grows too big. Austria: I'd rather not fight over TRI. Turkey: I'm open to a Mediterranean non-aggression pact covering GRE/TUN.

Russia to Turkey: I propose we stay out of each other's way. I won't move south into ARM/ANK/SMY areas, and I'd like the same from you toward SEV and RUM. Let's both focus on Austria and the Balkans-free centers (RUM, SWE, NWY) elsewhere. Open to a clear plan.

Russia to Germany: I'm keeping my armies on the Russia side of Warsaw and Prussia for now. I'm happy to talk about a stable border and about who takes SWE/DEN/NWY, since neither of us gains from fighting early.

Turkey here. Proposal: no attacks between us this year. I'll take BUL, GRE and SER from the neutral pool, and you take RUM. Black Sea stays yours, I won't move on SEV or ARM. Your F SEV and my F ANK can both stay put. Agree?
Turkey open to peace with all. I plan to expand into the Balkans (BUL, GRE, SER) and the Eastern Med. Happy to talk non-aggression with anyone who isn't attacking me.

Austria: Thanks for the replies. I'm holding defensively in 1901 and won't move into Germany, Italy or France. Russia: I'd like to keep Galicia and the Balkans calm; I won't push into Warsaw or Moscow if you don't push into Galicia or Bohemia. Turkey: I'll avoid Serbia and Rumania this year if you avoid Bulgaria-to-Serbia moves into my area. Open to a written mutual non-aggression pact.

Agreed. You take Iberia and Belgium, I go for Norway. Let's keep the Channel empty on both sides: no fleet of yours in ENG and none of mine there either. If either of us has to change plans, we tell the other first. Glad we can trust each other.
Sounds good. Denmark and Holland are yours, Norway is mine. I'll stay out of Helgoland if you do. Let's keep talking as the year goes on.

France to England: Deal. I keep the Channel and North Sea empty of my fleets, and I go for Iberia (Spain, Portugal). You take Norway and the north. I'll move BRE to MAO this turn and won't enter ENG or NTH.

France to Germany: Agreed on no contest. I'm not moving into Belgium or Burgundy-Ruhr-Munich areas against you. Let's both keep to our own neutral centers. Please keep your units out of Paris and Brest.
France to Italy: I'm not planning to move on Tunis this year. I'll take Spain and Portugal first. Let's keep the Mediterranean quiet between us.

Germany to France: Agreed on no attacks while we both keep out of each other's home centers. I plan to take Belgium and Holland this year, so please keep your units out of BEL and HOL. I'll stay out of PAR, BRE and MAR.
Germany to England: Agreed, no conflict in 1901. I'll take Denmark and Holland and keep my fleets out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep your units out of BEL and DEN.
Germany to Russia: I'm fine with a stable border. I won't move into WAR, PRU or LVN. I'm taking DEN/HOL/BEL, and I'll leave SWE and NWY to you if you want them. Let's keep it that way.

Italy to Austria: Agreed. Neither of us enters the other's home centers (VEN, ROM, NAP for me; TRI, VIE, BUD for you). I'm open to a formal pact for 1901 and will watch the Adriatic. Let's both focus on neutral centers (SER, GRE, TUN) and warn each other if Russia or Turkey move on us.

Italy to France: No plans against you. I'm moving toward Tunis and Greece-area neutrals, not Piedmont or Marseilles. If you take Spain and Portugal, I'll stay out of the western Med. Let's keep MAO and TYS clear of each other's fleets.
Russia to Turkey: Agreed. You take BUL, GRE, SER; I take RUM. Black Sea and ARM/SEV stay as they are. I won't move south of RUM. Let's keep it that way.
Russia to England: Agreed on the north. I'll aim for SWE and keep my fleets out of the North Sea and Norway. You keep NWY and stay out of STP and LVN.
Russia to Germany: Agreed, no attacks in 1901. I'm not targeting PRU or SIL. I'd like to keep WAR/PRU border stable, and I'm fine with you taking DEN, HOL, BEL.
Russia to Austria: I'm not planning to attack you. I'm interested in RUM. If you keep your units out of RUM and SEV, we're fine. Let me know if you plan to move on GAL.

Turkey to Russia: agreed on staying out of each other's way. I'll keep A SMY and A CON south of ARM/SEV, and F ANK out of BLA. Taking BUL/GRE/SER only; RUM is yours. If you want to work against Austria later, I'm open to that once we see who moves first.
Turkey to Austria: I won't enter TRI, BUD or VIE. My Balkan moves are BUL, GRE and SER. If you keep your units out of GRE and BUL, we have no reason to clash this year. Please confirm.
Turkey: I'm holding a defensive posture in 1901 and will not attack any power that does not attack me first. Open to a non-aggression pact with Italy in the Mediterranean (GRE/TUN left alone).

Austria, round 3: Thanks all. I'm holding my home centers in 1901 and will not enter Italy, Germany or France. Turkey: I'll stay out of GRE and BUL this year, and I'm watching SER. Russia: I won't move on RUM or SEV this year. Proposal: no one moves into SER, RUM or GRE in 1901 unless attacked. If anyone wants a written mutual non-aggression pact, send me the text and I'll sign it.
Agreed. Norway is mine, Sweden is yours. I stay out of STP and LVN, you keep out of NWY, NTH and BAR. Good luck in the south. Let's stay in touch.
Good, so BRE goes to MAO and neither of us enters ENG. Have a good year in Iberia. Tell me if Germany starts heading for Belgium or Burgundy.
Confirmed. I stay out of BEL, DEN and HEL, and you stay out of NTH and NWY. Share whatever you hear about France's plans.

France: Holding to my word. I'm moving west into Iberia (Spain, Portugal) and keeping fleets out of ENG, NTH and the Italian/Balkan areas. I'll respect any written non-aggression that the others also keep. Happy to share intel on any power that breaks a deal.
France to Germany: Confirmed. I won't enter BEL or HOL. Please keep your units out of PAR, BRE and MAR and we're fine.

Germany here. Still committed to peace in 1901. I'm taking DEN, HOL and BEL this year and will not enter PAR, BRE, MAR, WAR, PRU, LVN or NWY. Austria and Italy: I'm happy to keep Bohemia and Tyrolia quiet if you keep your units off Munich and Berlin. Anyone who attacks my home centers will find me ready to defend.

Italy to Turkey: Agreed on a Mediterranean non-aggression pact. I won't move on Greece or Tunis while you stay out of Apulia, Naples and Venice. If you want a written pact, say so and we can post it globally.
Italy to Austria: Confirmed. No Italian moves into TRI, VIE or BUD, and I expect the same for VEN, ROM and NAP. Let's keep the Adriatic quiet this year.

Russia to Austria: Agreed on a written mutual non-aggression pact for 1901. I won't move into GAL, BOH or BUD/VIE. Please keep your units out of RUM, UKR and SEV. If you move into RUM this spring I will treat it as hostile.
Russia to Turkey: Confirmed. I'm moving on RUM only and staying out of BUL/GRE/SER. Please keep A SMY and F ANK out of BLA and SEV.
Turkey to Austria: Confirmed. I won't enter TRI, BUD, VIE or SER/RUM this year. I'm taking BUL and GRE only. If you stay out of BUL and GRE, we're at peace. Happy to write it down.
Turkey to Italy: Agreed on a Mediterranean non-aggression pact. I won't move on TUN, NAP or ROM, and I'd like GRE/ION left alone by you. Let's keep the Adriatic and Ionian quiet in 1901.

Austria, round 4: Confirming my 1901 stance. I will not enter GER, ITA or FRA home centers, and I will not move into SER, RUM, GRE, BUL, SEV or UKR this spring. Russia and Turkey: you both claim RUM/SER/BUL/GRE. Please state which of you is moving where so we don't collide. If either of you enters a Balkan center I'll reassess. I'm happy to sign a written 1901 non-aggression pact with each of you.

Heads up: Germany just announced publicly that it's taking BEL this year, as well as DEN and HOL. That clashes with what you and I agreed. You might want an army heading for Burgundy or Picardy. I'm keeping to our deal: Norway for me, no fleet of mine in ENG.
Still on track: Norway for me, and I stay out of HEL, DEN and BEL. Just so you know, France expects to get Belgium, so watch Burgundy.
France to Germany: Confirmed. I'm going into Spain and Portugal, not Belgium or Holland. Please keep your units out of Paris, Brest and Marseilles and we stay at peace.
France to England: Still on. BRE goes to MAO, and I'm not entering ENG or NTH. Norway and the north are yours.

Germany, round 4: Thanks all. Confirming my 1901 plan: DEN, HOL and BEL only. I will not enter PAR, BRE, MAR, WAR, PRU, LVN, NWY or SWE. Austria and Italy: I'll keep Bohemia and Tyrolia quiet if you keep off MUN and BER. Russia: our WAR/PRU border stays as agreed. If anyone breaks these terms, please tell the table so we can respond together.

Italy, round 4: Still committed to peace in 1901. My Med pacts with Austria and Turkey stand: no Italian moves into TRI, VIE, BUD, GRE or TUN, and I expect no moves into VEN, ROM, NAP or APU. France: I'm staying out of the western Med and Spain/Portugal. Germany: noted on DEN/HOL/BEL, no objection. Let's see who keeps their word this year.

Russia to Austria: Confirming our 1901 non-aggression as I stated. I'm not moving on GAL, BOH, BUD or VIE. Please keep your units out of RUM, UKR and SEV, and I'll do the same toward your home centers.
Russia to Turkey: Still on track. I take RUM this spring, you take BUL/GRE/SER. Please keep A SMY and F ANK out of BLA and SEV, and I'll keep my fleet out of the Aegean.

Turkey, round 4: Still holding to the split. I'm moving only into BUL, GRE and SER this year, and I'm staying out of RUM, TRI, BUD, VIE, TUN and the Adriatic. Anyone who keeps the same terms gets no trouble from me. Happy to put a written non-aggression pact in writing with Russia, Austria and Italy.

Austria, round 5: Final confirmation of my 1901 terms. I will hold all units this spring and will not enter GER, ITA or FRA home centers, nor SER, RUM, GRE, BUL, SEV, UKR, GAL or BOH. Russia, Turkey, Italy: I'm glad to see the terms hold. If anyone breaks them, tell the table and I'll respond with you. Happy to keep the Balkans split as agreed.
Confirmed on my side too. No English fleet goes into ENG this spring and I'm going north. Let's compare notes after the moves.
Confirmed: Norway for me, Sweden for you, and I stay out of STP and BAR. Good luck.

France to Germany: You've now announced BEL, DEN and HOL publicly, which is not what we agreed. I expected you to keep out of BEL. Please confirm in this round that you will not move into BEL or BUR this spring. If you do, I will treat it as a breach and respond with my armies.
France to England: Thanks for keeping to our deal. I'm moving into Spain and Portugal and staying out of ENG and NTH. If Germany takes Belgium, I'll expect you to back me in the Channel.

France: I'm holding my word. I'm moving into Iberia (Spain and Portugal) and keeping fleets out of ENG, NTH and the Italian and Balkan areas. Any power that moves into my home centers (PAR, BRE, MAR) will face my full response.

Germany, round 5: Final confirmation for 1901. I move only into DEN, HOL and BEL, and I stay out of PAR, BRE, MAR, WAR, PRU, LVN, NWY and SWE. Anyone who keeps the same terms gets no trouble from me. If any power moves against these terms, please say so at the table.

Russia to Austria, final round: I'm moving A WAR and F SEV into RUM this spring as agreed, and I'm not touching GAL, BOH, BUD or VIE. Please keep your units out of RUM, UKR and SEV. Let's both keep the 1901 peace.
Russia to Turkey, final round: Confirmed. I take RUM only. You keep to BUL/GRE/SER, and A SMY and F ANK stay out of BLA and SEV. Thanks for keeping to the split.
Russia: Confirming the 1901 terms. I'm taking RUM and SWE in the south and north, and I'm staying out of NWY, DEN, HOL, BEL, PRU and LVN. Keep to your own centers and we'll all grow peacefully.

Turkey, round 5: Final restatement. I move only into BUL, GRE and SER this spring. No moves on RUM, TRI, BUD, VIE, TUN, the Adriatic or the Black Sea. Russia, Italy and Austria: if you keep the same terms, I will not attack you in 1901.

Austria, F1901 round 1: Russia's fall moves put A UKR, A SEV and F RUM into the Balkan and Black Sea area, which is not the 1901 terms we discussed. I'm reassessing. I plan to move on Serbia this Fall to recover my position. Turkey: I'll stay out of BUL and GRE. Italy: I'm keeping the Adriatic quiet and my home centers are not a target. Russia: stay out of GAL, BOH, BUD and VIE and we are fine.

England: Spring went as agreed, thanks. This fall I take Norway. Where is A RUH going, HOL or BEL? France keeps telling me Belgium is his. If you take HOL with KIE and leave BEL alone, France has no reason to fight you, and you and I can stay friends. What are your plans?

England: Good spring, and thanks for keeping ENG empty. I'm taking Norway this fall. Germany's A RUH is right next to BEL. Are you sending A PAR to BUR or PIC to contest it? Is MAO heading for POR? I'm keeping ENG empty as promised.
England: Spring went as agreed. F BOT to SWE and me to NWY, then. No English unit goes near STP. Good luck in RUM.

Germany to France: Fair point on BEL. For Fall 1901 I will not move into BEL or BUR, and I will keep PAR, BRE and MAR off my list. Please do the same for HOL, RUH and KIE. We both took neutral centers in Spring, so let's hold our lines this Fall.

Germany: Spring results show Russia in RUM and Turkey in BUL, so the Balkan split is already moving. I took DEN and I will hold my home centers and HOL/BEL for now. Please say what you plan for Fall so we avoid collisions.

Italy, F1901: Spring moves were quiet on my border. Turkey now has A BUL, which is in line with the Balkan split. I'm holding VEN, ROM and NAP, and I'm moving F ION toward GRE/TUN space only if Turkey confirms it is not going there. Austria: I'm keeping the Adriatic and TRI/VIE/BUD off limits. Anyone who wants to adjust the Mediterranean split, message me now.
Italy to Turkey: You moved CON-BUL. Are you taking GRE and SER this autumn? If so, I'll keep F ION out of GRE and stay put. Please confirm you won't move into APU, NAP or VEN.

Russia, Fall 1901: I hold RUM and am taking SWE with F BOT. I have no plans against Austria, Turkey or Germany. Austria and Turkey, you both pledged to stay out of RUM and the Black Sea; I'll hold you to that. Happy to keep the peace while we all grow.

Turkey, F1901 round 1: Thanks for keeping the split. A BUL is in place. I still plan only GRE and SER from here. Austria, I'd like you to stay out of SER and GRE this fall, and I'll stay out of TRI, BUD and VIE. Russia, RUM is yours as agreed and I won't touch it. Italy, the Med pact stands. Happy to put this in writing.

Austria to Italy and Turkey: Russia has moved into RUM and UKR, breaking the 1901 terms. Russia now has 4+ centers and a big Balkan presence. I propose we coordinate. Turkey: I will not attack your units in BUL or GRE. Please keep your army off SER if I take it this Fall, and let's agree on who moves where. Italy: please keep your Adriatic and Balkan options open for a joint response to Russia. Reply with your Fall orders by next round.

Austria, F1901 round 2: Russia's RUM and UKR moves were not part of our 1901 terms. I'm not attacking anyone's home centers. I'm looking at Serbia as an unowned center. Russia: please confirm you will not move on GAL, BOH, BUD or VIE this Fall.
England: My fall is simple: Norway only. No move on HOL, BEL, DEN or HEL. If you take HOL and leave BEL alone, I think France stays calm. Want to keep comparing notes on France and Russia?
England: Confirmed. I take NWY this fall and nothing else up north. SWE is yours. Let's keep Scandinavia split cleanly. Germany now holds DEN next to Sweden, so keep an eye on it.

France to England: Yes, MAO is going to POR this Fall, and A SPA holds Spain. I'm not sending fleets into ENG or NTH. Good luck taking Norway. If Germany moves on Belgium, I'd welcome your help in the Channel.
France to Germany: Agreed, no moves into BEL or BUR this Fall from either side. My A PAR stays at home. Please keep RUH, KIE and HOL on your side of the line, and we're fine.

France: Fall plan is defensive. A SPA holds, F MAO goes to Portugal, A PAR holds Paris. I'm not moving into Belgium, Burgundy, Tunis or the Balkans. Italy and Austria: no France moves toward your centers. Russia and Turkey: keep the Balkan terms, please.

Germany to England: My Fall plan is A RUH to HOL and no move into BEL. Your Norway plan is fine by me. Please keep fleets out of HEL and DEN, which are mine now. Let's stay friends and watch France's moves into BEL and BUR.
Germany to France: I confirm I will not enter BEL or BUR this Fall. I am taking HOL only. Please keep your armies out of RUH, KIE and MUN, and we can both hold our lines.

Germany to Austria and Russia: Both of you have made Balkan and Black Sea moves that break the spring terms. I suggest we avoid a fight. Austria, please keep off Rumania. Russia, please keep off Galicia and Bohemia. I will stay out of your centers if you stay out of mine.

Italy to Austria: I'm keeping to our pact. VEN, ROM and NAP are not a target for me. Please confirm you won't enter TRI, VEN, APU or the Adriatic from Serbia or Bud, and I'll keep TUS and ADR clear of your fleets.
Italy to Turkey: Thanks for the reply. I'll keep F ION out of GRE and SER while you take them. Please confirm no Turkish move into APU, NAP, VEN or ION this fall, and I'll hold my Med pact.

Italy, F1901 round 2: I hold VEN, ROM and NAP and have no moves planned against anyone this fall. Russia: I note your SWE plan, which doesn't touch me. Germany: Italy has no objection to your DEN/HOL/BEL plan. Any power planning Adriatic or Tunis moves, tell me now.

Russia to Austria, F1901 round 2: My Spring move into RUM was the agreed centre, and I'm holding it. I have no plan against SER, BUD or VIE. If you move on SER, that is your business, but I will not enter Balkan centres you target. Keep your units out of RUM, UKR and SEV and we stay at peace. I'm open to a written pact on that basis.

Russia to Turkey: I'm holding RUM and SEV defensively. I have no move planned on BUL or GRE. Please keep F ANK and A SMY out of BLA and SEV, and tell me if Austria moves toward SER or BUL so we can coordinate.

Russia, F1901: I'm defending my new centre RUM and home centres. I'm not attacking anyone this fall and I'd welcome a stable Balkan split with Austria and Turkey. Anyone who moves into RUM, SEV or WAR will face a full response.

Turkey to Austria: I'm taking GRE and SER this Fall with A BUL and support. If you move on SER we both bounce and Russia gains. Suggest you hold this fall, and we talk about a joint line against Russia's fleets in the Black Sea and Rumania later. Your answer?

Turkey to Russia: RUM is yours as agreed, I won't touch it. Keep F RUM and A SEV out of BUL and SER, and keep F ANK out of your BLA/SEV plans. Please confirm you are not moving on Bulgaria or Serbia this fall.
Turkey to Italy: I'm moving A BUL to GRE/SER this Fall, not into the Ionian or Tunis. Keep the Med pact. I'll keep F ANK and A SMY out of Greece's sea and the Adriatic.

Austria to Turkey: We both want SER. Proposal: I take SER this Fall with A BUD. You take GRE with A BUL. I won't touch GRE or BUL. Let's then coordinate against Russia's RUM and UKR units in the spring. Please confirm, so we don't bounce each other.

Austria to Italy: Thanks for the pact. I'm taking SER this Fall and holding TRI/VIE/BUD. I'll keep the Adriatic quiet. If Russia pushes further into the Balkans, let's coordinate a joint answer in 1902.

Austria, F1901 round 3: Russia, your RUM and UKR moves are not what we agreed. I'm holding GAL and BOH and I expect you to stay off BUD and VIE. I'll respond if Russia moves on Galicia. Germany and France: I'm not targeting your centers.
England: Good, RUH to HOL works for me. I'm going to Norway, and I'm staying out of HEL and DEN. Let's keep an eye on France together.
England: Thanks. POR and SPA give you a strong year. I'm on Norway. ENG stays empty from my side.
France to Germany: Thanks for confirming no BEL or BUR this Fall. I'm holding A PAR and moving F MAO to POR. Please keep RUH, KIE and MUN on your side of the line.
France to England: Still on. MAO goes to POR and A SPA holds. No French fleets in ENG or NTH. Good luck in Norway.
Germany to France: Confirmed again. I will not enter BEL or BUR this Fall. My only Fall move is A RUH to HOL. Please keep your armies out of RUH, KIE and MUN and we stay at peace.

Germany, F1901 round 3: I am holding my home centres and moving only A RUH to HOL. No moves into BEL, BUR, DEN-adjacent English or Russian areas, or Austrian/Italian home centres. Russia and Austria: please state whether you will respect the Balkan split (Austria off RUM, Russia off GAL/BOH/BUD/VIE). Anyone who breaks these terms should be named at the table.

Italy to Austria: Noted on Russia. I'm open to coordinating against Russia's growth, but I'm not ready to commit forces to the Balkans yet. Italy keeps VEN, ROM, NAP and the Adriatic closed to your units, and I expect the same. If you move on SER, tell me your plan first.
Italy to Turkey: Med pact stands. I'm not moving F ION into GRE or SER while you take them. Please keep APU, NAP, VEN and ION clear this fall.

Russia to Austria, F1901 round 3: I'm not moving on GAL, BOH, BUD or VIE, and I have no plans against SER. My RUM and SEV units are defensive, not aimed at you. Let's sign a written pact: Russia stays out of Austria's home centres and Serbia, and Austria stays out of RUM, UKR, SEV and WAR. Reply and I'll confirm in writing.

Russia to Turkey: Confirmed, I won't move on BUL, GRE or SER this fall. RUM and SEV stay defensive. Please keep F ANK and A SMY out of BLA and SEV, and tell me if Austria moves toward BUL. If you want, we can coordinate a stance against any Austrian push into the Balkans.

Russia: Fall plan is defensive. I hold RUM, SEV, WAR and my home centres, and F BOT goes to SWE. I'm not moving toward your centres. If anyone plans an attack on RUM, SEV or WAR, tell me now so we can respond together.

Turkey to Austria: Serbia is contested. If you move A BUD or TRI/VIE into SER, we bounce and Russia gains from RUM. I'm moving A BUL toward GRE and SER this Fall. Propose you hold this Fall, and we agree a written split: I take GRE and SER, you keep your home centers and look at RUM/UKR together later. Reply by next round.

Turkey to Russia: Your RUM move is noted and I'm not contesting it. But A SEV and F RUM moving into the Balkans worries me. Confirm you won't move on BUL or SER this Fall, and I'll keep F ANK and A SMY out of BLA and SEV.
Turkey to Italy: Confirmed, no Turkish moves into ION, APU, NAP, VEN or TUN this Fall. F ION stays out of GRE/SER while I take them. Med pact stands.

Austria to Turkey: Agreed on a split. I will hold this Fall and not move into SER or GRE. You take SER and GRE. Let's make a written pact to coordinate against Russia's RUM and UKR units in 1902, and I'll keep GAL and BOH closed to Russia.

Austria to Italy: I'm holding this Fall and not taking SER. Russia now holds RUM, UKR and SEV and is the threat to both of us. Let's agree to coordinate in 1902 and keep the Adriatic and Tunis closed to each other.
England: All clear on my side. Is F DEN holding or going to SWE? Russia says F BOT is heading for SWE, so you two may bounce there. Just letting you know.
England: Thanks. Germany's F DEN is next to SWE, so it might contest your F BOT. I'm only going to NWY.

France to Germany: Good that you're holding to BEL/BUR. Keep A RUH out of BUR and PAR this Fall and I'll hold A PAR and keep my fleets away from DEN/HOL. If you move on BUR or PIC, I'll treat it as a breach.
France to England: MAO to POR and A SPA holds, no French fleets in ENG or NTH. If Germany takes Belgium or moves on Paris, please back me in the Channel.

Germany, F1901 round 4: Still holding. My only Fall move is A RUH to HOL. No entry into BEL, BUR, PAR, BRE, MAR, WAR, RUM, GAL or the Austrian and Italian home centres. Russia and Austria: please confirm you will keep to the Balkan split and stay off each other's centres this Fall.

Italy: Austria and Turkey both claim SER for Fall. Please say who takes SER before orders lock. I'm not joining a Balkan attack yet. Italy keeps VEN, ROM, NAP and the Adriatic closed to all non-Italian units. Med pact with Turkey stands.
Italy to Russia: I have no moves against you. Please keep your fleets out of the Ionian and Adriatic and I'll do the same. Let's keep the south quiet.

Russia to Turkey, F1901 round 4: Confirmed. I will not move on BUL, GRE or SER this Fall. RUM and SEV stay defensive. I'll keep F RUM and A SEV out of Bulgaria. Please keep F ANK and A SMY out of BLA and SEV, and let's watch Austria together.

Russia to Austria, F1901 round 4: I am not moving on GAL, BOH, BUD or VIE this Fall, and I have no plan against SER. RUM and SEV are defensive. If you keep your units out of RUM, UKR, SEV and WAR, we stay at peace. Tell me if you will sign that.

Turkey to Austria: I'm taking SER with A BUL this Fall, and I'm not moving into GRE or your home centers. If you move A BUD into SER we bounce and Russia gains from RUM. Please hold this Fall and we can discuss RUM/UKR against Russia in the spring.
Turkey to Russia: Confirmed, no Turkish move into RUM, and I keep F ANK and A SMY out of BLA and SEV. Please stay off BUL, GRE and SER this Fall.
Turkey to Italy: Med pact stands. I'm not moving into ION, APU, NAP, VEN or TUN this Fall.

Austria to Turkey, F1901 round 5: Confirmed. I hold A BUD, A VIE and F TRI this Fall and will not enter SER or GRE. Take SER. In 1902 let's coordinate against Russia's RUM, UKR and SEV units. Please confirm you will keep A BUL out of TRI, BUD and VIE.

Austria to Italy, F1901 round 5: I'm holding this Fall and keeping TRI, VIE and BUD closed to you. Let's keep the Adriatic and Tunis quiet and coordinate against Russia in 1902. Please keep F ION out of Austrian waters.
England: Understood. If Germany moves against you, I'll take it seriously. Let's talk in winter about working together against Germany in 1902.
England: Thanks for being open with me. Good luck with HOL. Let's talk in winter about how we handle France and Russia.
France to Germany: Confirmed. A PAR holds, and I'm not moving into BEL, BUR or HOL. Your A RUH to HOL is fine by me. Please keep RUH, KIE and MUN off Paris and Burgundy.
